OUR MISSION IS TO ENABLE EVERYONE TO BUILD WEALTH

We reinvent how trading and investing work by creating exceptional products people love.

Fostering a culture of excellence and high velocity is the key to our success.

Тoday, we serve over 5 million clients, with more than €30 billion in assets under management - a testament to the scale and trust we’ve built in just a few years.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Analyze & Optimize: Dissect existing or define new workflows, implement data-driven improvements, monitor Key Performance Indicators to ensure improvements are achieved and sustained

Structured Problem Solving: Break down complex operational challenges into manageable, logical workstreams to solve problems at their root

Full Ownership: Take accountability for the processes under your stewardship. You aren't just making suggestions; you have a relentless focus on getting things done and monitoring the long-term results

Stakeholder Management: Navigate a fast-paced environment by collaborating with Engineering, Compliance, Customer Success, and Product teams to understand and align key objectives and requirements to realise business value for leadership

WHAT YOU NEED TO HAVE

- Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset.

- Basic programming skills (Python, SQL, or similar)

- Data visualisation/dashboarding skills (Tableau, Looker, PowerBI or similar)

- Ability to document processes clearly and work in a structured way

- Curiosity about fintech, financial markets

- Familiarity with AI/ML tools for pattern recognition and/or automation

NICE TO HAVE

- Process improvement certification (Lean Six Sigma)

- Project management certification (PMP, PRINCE2)

- Prior data engineering experience (ETL pipelines, APIs, cloud data platforms)

WHAT WE OFFER

- Challenges that will help you grow and realise your potential

- Opportunity to make a big impact - you will build innovative services used by millions of investors to build wealth

- Work with smart, spirited, helpful, high-performing colleagues with a common goal

- An environment where nothing is set in stone

- Appreciation for your talent and ideas

- Generous remuneration package including annual bonuses

Bring your ambition to Europe’s fastest-growing mobile broker!
